text: Hello everyone, welcome back to our English class.I'm Anna.Today, we are going to write an article to introduce a traditional Chinese skill.We will learn how to describe an artist, a traditional skill, and the things the artist uses.In a previous lesson, we learned how to describe people.Let's read a paragraph about Daming and figure out how the writer describes him.Daming is a fisherman, tells us his job.From the word elderly and his age, we know he is in old age group.He is thin, is about his build.Of average height, talks about his height.From he is fit and he is strong, we know his health condition.The writer describes Daming from these aspects and gives us many details in order to show a vivid picture of a common fisherman who lives and works with his birds.Today, we will write an article to describe another person who has a traditional job.Here are some sentences about the artist.Who is he?ChenWhat is he?He is a clay sculptor.What kind of traditional skill is he working on?Clay sculpting.Today, we will write an introduction to Mr.Chen and clay sculpting.I wonder whether you have enough background information, so I have some questions to ask you.The first question.What does he look like?Please write a description of him in task one on the worksheet.OK, and here is one of my student's practice work.Let's read it and check whether Mr.Chen is described vividly.Chen is a clay sculptor.He has been working on clay sculpting for many years.Now he is a middle-aged man.He is fat.He has a round face with black hair and mustache.He has strong arms, big hands, and flexible fingers.Betty tells us many details about him.Good job, Betty.But today's topic is to introduce clay sculpting.Must we list as much information about Mr.Chen as we can?In fact, some sentences in this paragraph have nothing to do with the traditional skill.Let's look at the sentences.The first one tells us his job.These two sentences show maybe he has rich working experience.Then something about his body shape, hair, and mustache.Are they necessary information?They have nothing to do with clay sculpting.What about the last sentence?Strong arms, big hands, and flexible fingers are very important for a clay sculptor to create artwork.Here comes a tip for you.Stick to the point.The second question.What does he use for his work?Look at the pictures.Do you know what they are?A set of sculpting tools.Clay and painting brushes.However, knowing their names is not enough.We can describe them.When we describe something, we will talk about the color, the size, the shape, the use, the material, and so on.Must we mention all of them?No, we don't have to.Let's take a look at the description of the tools.Does it show us the color or the size?It tells us the material, the shape, and the use.They help us to have a better understanding of what the tools are like and how they work during the process.Now, please describe the clay and the painting brushes.Write some sentences about them in Task 2 on the worksheet.Please write some sentences about them in Task 2 on the worksheet.Time's up.My student, Betty, writes her description like this.Chen uses the clay to make the clay face.Chen uses the clay to make the clay figures.It's about the use.And the next one.The painting brushes are used to color the clay figures.The sentence also tells us the use of the brushes.As you can see, we don't have to tell everything.Remember to stick to the point.Question 3.How does he do his work?This may be a difficult question, but don't worry.Here are some pictures to help you.What does each picture mean?Please fill in the blanks with proper verbs.Let's check the answers.The first picture shows how people turn or transform the clay into vivid clay figures.The second picture.Paint the base color.What about the third picture?Draw the faces.Please look at the sentence.He turns the clay into vivid clay figures.It shows the action.To make it more lively.Can you show any other details?For example, you can write in this way.He turns the clay into vivid clay figures carefully.The adverb shows the manner.That is, in what way something is done.What else can be filled in the blank?How about this sentence?He turns the clay into vivid clay figures by using his hands and different tools.By doing something shows the method of doing something.And here is another sentence.He turns the clay into vivid clay figures to make them look real.The red part tells us the purpose of doing so.As you can see, when we describe how something is done, it's necessary for us to give more details like the manner, the method, and the purpose of doing so.Here are two sentences.Please rewrite the sentences and add more details.That's task three on the worksheet.Now, let's read Betty's sentences.The first one.He paints the base color for several times to make the color lasting.It tells us how he paints the color and why he does so.The second one.He draws the face carefully.He draws the face carefully to make the clay figure look real.It shows the manner and the purpose.So here is another tip for you.Give more details.Then let's move on to the fourth question.How do you feel about clay sculpting?When we talk about feelings, we will think of many words like happy, excited, sad, frustrated, and so on.But in writing, we had better give some explanations.Take this as an example.Please read the sentences and fill in the blank.Since clay sculpting serves as a window for the whole world to learn about Chinese culture, I feel very happy or proud.According to the supporting details, the readers can achieve a better understanding of the feelings.Let's do more practice.Can you hear me?Can you complete the sentence?Some students may say, However, I am also very worried because few people are learning it, and clay sculpting may disappear one day.Does it make sense?With the reason, we know the situation is really worrying, and more people are needed to protect the traditional skill.So again, remember to give more details.And now, I believe you have already known clay sculpting.Please write an article describing Mr.Write four paragraphs with the following details.How does he do it?How do you feel about the traditional skill?Please write an article in task four on your worksheet.I feel like I'm getting a little dizzy.I hope you can understand.I'm gonna go to bed now.Good night.搅拌均匀放入泡沫再搅拌均匀搅拌均匀【音乐】时间到了。如果您还没完成写作,不过没关系。我喜欢和您分享凡妮的作品。在读书时,请帮忙查看她的作品。陈先生是一位木工师。他已经很多年在木工上工作了。现在,他是一位中年人。他有强壮的腕部、大手臂,并且有轻松的手指。当他工作时,他需要一套创作工具,特殊的木材,还有画画刀。这些工具是用木材做的。他们有不同的形状和不同的用途。陈先生在他的工作室工作。通常,他会把木材轻松地把木材切成木材。接着,他会几次用底色来保持颜色。脸上的表现是最重要的部分。他把脸上的每个细节都画出来,让它们看起来像真实的一样。木材创作有很长的历史。我感到很高兴看到木材创作是整个世界的环境,让我们学习中国文化。看看你的工作室的检测表。她回答了四个问题吗?是的,每一篇文章都回答了一个问题。她追求了这个问题吗?每一篇文章都回答了一个问题。她把陈先生和他的技巧描述在详细中吗?我们可以找到陈先生的详细,他使用的工具,还有木材创作。在最后一篇文章中,她表达了她的感受,以支持详细。因此,她可以得到每一篇文章。您可以在详细中检查您的工作,并在详细中刮痕。在今天的课程中,我们写了陈先生和木材创作的介绍。我们学会了继续分析,并提供更多的详细。希望您喜欢今天的课程。这里是今天的家庭工作。
